units.rawText: Life at the Oasis here is good. Other than what is necessary for work, I've learnt some new things.
units.displayText: Life at the Oasis here is good. Other than what is necessary for work, I've learnt some new things.

spans.text: Life at the Oasis here is good. Other than what is necessary for work, I've learnt some new things.

units.rawText: The things that could never have been gleaned in the fires of a real battlefield, such as how to steady yourself and truly relax.
units.displayText: The things that could never have been gleaned in the fires of a real battlefield, such as how to steady yourself and truly relax.

spans.text: The things that could never have been gleaned in the fires of a real battlefield, such as how to steady yourself and truly relax.

units.rawText: There's no need for you to worry, <cmdr>. An area within my mental module continually reminds me, "Clukay is here for you." The methods of relaxation and those reminders will not impact my capabilities in the slightest.

units.rawText: On the contrary, they make me stronger to protect you, and for victory.
